_extraction_context.snippet_primary: "I certainly don't recommend purchasing anything from this company because you can't take a complaint to a real person directly by phone, email or text. I was scammed in relation to a supplement I bought & there was just no way to quickly query this without going through a ridiculous procedure. Furthermore, ETSY should vet these supplement sellers before accrediting them - in this case it was a bogus company not located in the country ETSY said it was; the product was not sent from the country ETSY said it would be; & the parcel labels showed it was sent from China while the parcel tracking showed it was en route from Thailand (which it wasn't!)."
